An engineer's logic, a designer's eye.

I'm a UI/UX and Graphic Designer with a B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering from AVS Engineering College and specialised training in UI/UX Design from BUFF Creative College, Coimbatore.

My engineering background shapes the way I approach design — combining structured problem-solving with strong visual thinking. During my 6-month UI/UX design internship, I worked on real-world interfaces, design systems, and visual assets.
